ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (30) has a matching target block, with page markers, numbering, quotation structure, and italics preserved.

Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (omissions, additions, generic he/his, terminology, attribution form).

Attributions follow the print (The Laws of Manu, Epictetus, Lucy Mallory, Thoreau); in the Manu passage «разум» (razum, 'reason') and «ум» (um, 'mind') are kept distinct, and pronouns for God stay lowercase as in the source. In no. 6 the sudden first person «да не могу» (da ne mogu, 'but I can't') is kept as printed, and the repeated «беда» (beda, 'trouble') is kept as one word.
Source observation: [12] a comma is missing after «в божественном разуме» before «он не может» (minor punctuation slip); translated with the evident sense
